what_this_is: W1.1 faithful fWAR replica scored component by component against the published StatsAPI sabermetrics feed (FanGraphs' WAR line)

gate.rule: a component clears a season when >= 99% of its rows sit within 1.0 run

built: positional (FG ladder, DH from B-Ref Inn, pitcher-batting credit)
consumed: batting park factor (LOO back-solve from feed Batting)
pitcher framing charge (FanGraphs pitching-leaderboard CFraming, convention 9)
pitching park factor (FanGraphs Guts FIP park factor per team-season; LOO back-solve from feed FIP- where the season is not cached)

fangraphs_inputs.source: fg_leaderboards.py cache (.cache/fangraphs), never fetched by this tool
fangraphs_inputs.note: owner decision 14a (2026-09-11): IFFB and the FIP park factor from FanGraphs; decision 13: CFraming cross-checked against the feed residual

war_runs_note: war_runs is (replica WAR - feed WAR) times the season RPW, so both sides are gated in runs

framing.source: rar minus the six published components, kept for players with catcher innings

park_factor.method: leave-one-out back-solve from feed Batting, PA-weighted over single-team hitters with PA >= 30

park_factor.source: fg_fip (FanGraphs Guts FIP park factor per team-season)

loo_fip_minus.method: leave-one-out back-solve from feed FIP-, IP-weighted over single-team pitchers with IP >= 20

pitchers.pf_source: fg_fip (FanGraphs Guts FIP park factor per team-season)
pitchers.framing_charge: FanGraphs pitcher CFraming, runs per nine after the park factor (convention 9)
